Burger King Vietnam is a TERRIBLE DISASTER as a whole Organization !
Oct 2019
Long words short : Burger King Vietnam is a TERRIBLE DISASTER as a whole Organization !

Burger King restaurant in HCMC, Phu My Hung tried to cheat us.. Then we called their customer 

service, but it is more terrible than their restaurants, nobody helped us to solve the issue.. 

Just for a simple problem which has an extreme simple solution, I had to make around 15 times phone 

conversation in 2 hours, contacted their Facebook site and chat, and submit their web form and send 

directly email to them..

BUT FINALLY THEY DO NOT DO ANYTHING !

I never see this much terrible customer service before ... Burger King Vietnam is Total DISASTER !!!

STORY was as this : They said that there is a promotion "Buy 1 get 1 Free" and we ordered 2 

Tendergrill Burgers, 4 Whoopers, 3 Chicken Burgers for delivery to home.. Which means they will bring 

the DOUBLE of all quantities..

We buy them and after that when we open the packages we saw that all of them are double quantity, 

except Whoopers.. Whoopers must be 8 but they bring ONLY 4...So we called back the restaurant again 

to tell this, after 5 minutes checking they called back us and said "SORRY the other burgers written 

as in Promotion but we forgot to write Whoopers in promotion..we are sending 4 more now"

We thought that they are correcting their mistake and started to wait their 2nd delivery. But when 

this 2nd delivery arrived THEY TRIED TO CHARGE US AGAIN for this NEW 4 Whooper AGAIN !!!!

Can you imagine this? They are not thinking about correcting any mistake (if it is a really 

mistake) but they are requesting more money this time..
Additionally I am not sure this is a REAL mistake or intentionally they did this..In the same bill 

HOW CAN 1ST ITEM IN PROMOTION, 2ND ITEM OUT OF PROMOTION, AND 3RD ITEM IN PROMOTION AGAIN??? I cannot 

understand this !!! What kind of mistake is this???

It looks like they are PLAYING WITH US..
It was like a very bad joke that they require payment again in the 2nd delivery, instead of 

correcting the wrong situation !!

Since 7pm until 9.30pm we made maybe 15 phone conversation both with restaurant and with Burger King 

Headquarters ...BUT NO SOLUTION came for this simple problem !!!!

And the second part of the DISASTER was their Customer Service. It is MUCH MUCH MORE TERRIBLE than 

their restaurant..

I've recorded all phone calls into my phone, I have strong evidence.
In this 2 hours , totally 6 times they said me "Please hang up the phone, our manager will call you
